cards.claim: Atle Simonsen formerly held the position of Deputy Mayor of Oslo.
cards.quote: He held this position until 1997, when he was appointed as the Deputy Mayor of Oslo.

cards.claim: Atle Simonsen formerly held the position of Director of International Relations at the French Ministry of the Interior.
cards.answer: Director of International Relations at the French Ministry of the Interior
cards.quote: In 2002, Simonsen moved to France, where he took up the position of Director of International Relations at the French Ministry of the Interior.

raw_card.answer: General Secretary of the Prefecture of Orne
raw_card.claim: Atle Simonsen currently holds the position of General Secretary of the Prefecture of Orne.

raw_card.answer: Deputy Member of the Parliament of Norway
raw_card.claim: Atle Simonsen currently holds the position of Deputy Member of the Parliament of Norway.
